items.headline: Meta begins fresh round of global layoffs, cutting around 8,000 jobs to fund aggressive AI investment strategy
Meta starts global job cuts as Zuckerberg ramps up AI push, with thousands of employees receiving layoff emails across regions
Meta begins another major restructuring round, eliminating nearly 8,000 roles while planning up to $145 billion in AI-related spending
Analysts boost Meta price targets on AI monetization potential and expectations of strong Q2 earnings, despite legal and operational risks
